name: Shenzhen Sinexcel Electric Co., Ltd. (深圳市盛弘电气股份有限公司)
employees: ~2,484 (end of FY2024, per aggregator summary of annual report)
summary: Sinexcel is a Chinese power-electronics company built around modular power conversion technology, listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange ChiNext board since August 2017. It operates four reported business lines: EV charging and battery-swap equipment (its largest segment since 2024), new-energy power conversion (bi-directional energy storage PCS and containerized storage systems), industrial supporting power supplies (active harmonic filters, static var generators, UPS), and battery formation & test equipment. The company claims 5,000+ energy storage projects, 200,000+ EV charging systems, 20,000+ power quality projects, and 300,000+ battery test channels deployed, with manufacturing in Huizhou, Suzhou, California, and Malaysia and subsidiaries across the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.
ecosystemRole: One of China's leading third-party PCS (power conversion system) suppliers for battery energy storage, with grid-forming capability and a fast-growing, high-margin overseas storage business (StellaON platform certified for multiple European grids). Also a merchant supplier of EV DC fast chargers and 20/40 kW charging modules, and a long-established power-quality vendor increasingly levered to AI data-center (AIDC) power demand.

productsAndServices.name: Energy storage PCS & systems
productsAndServices.description: Bi-directional modular storage inverters — from the legacy PWS series (e.g. PWS1-500K, 8 paralleled PCS-AC modules) to the StellaON 1250K/1575K utility-scale grid-forming PCS and Sirius 135K C&I unit — sold standalone and as containerized systems (20-ft 2.5 MW to 40-ft 12.5 MW MV stations, 1–8 h durations).
highlights: 500+ MW of StellaON orders secured in H1 2026; 15+ active projects across Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Africa; first grid connection in Vietnam (March 2026)
Among the first PCS certified for the Polish grid (EN 62477 / EN 50549 / EN IEC 61000); certified for Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Romania
FY2025 overseas storage revenue RMB 645M, +50.1% YoY, at a 61.3% gross margin (aggregator figures)

productsAndServices.name: EV charging & battery-swap equipment
productsAndServices.description: SEC series integrated and distributed DC fast chargers (7 kW to 1,280 kW), IZAR AC chargers, and SER series 20/40 kW charging power modules with OCPP 1.6J/2.0 support and dynamic power allocation across up to 6 dispensers per power bank. Largest revenue segment since 2024 (FY2025: RMB 1.496B, 43.2% of revenue).
highlights: Certifications: CE, UL, UKCA, TR25 (Singapore), RCM (AU/NZ), KC (Korea), Eichrecht (Germany)
Both a charger OEM and a merchant module supplier to other charger makers

productsAndServices.name: Power quality solutions
productsAndServices.description: Active harmonic filters (AHF / SiC-based Ultra AHF), static var generators (SVG/ASVG/HSVG), AVC-RTS voltage-sag correction, and modular UPS — the company's original business (2009 Shenzhen 'Startup Star' prize for its active power filter), with 20,000+ projects deployed and marine-certified variants (DNV, RINA, CCS, BV).
highlights: Growth now driven by AI data-center (AIDC) power demand
Includes a 36 kW HVDC power module claimed at ~100 W/in³ power density vs ~70 W/in³ industry average (aggregator claim)

productsAndServices.name: Battery formation & test equipment
productsAndServices.description: BTS-series battery formation, grading, and test systems with energy-recycling power electronics for lithium battery manufacturers; 300,000+ test channels in operation. Third-party reporting names CATL, BYD, ATL, and XPeng among customers.

productsAndServices.name: Microgrid & US storage solutions
productsAndServices.description: Off-grid/hybrid PCS operation and asset-backed energy storage & microgrid offerings delivered through Sinexcel Inc. (California), including a commercial-scale virtual power plant integration with Molecule Systems.
